about_the_game:
Step into the ultimate virtual nightlife experience with Night Life: Club Sessions. Explore in first-person or third-person using your keyboard, mouse, or gamepad. Create and customise your avatar, relax in your own private space, or dive into immersive club sessions where music, lights and atmosphere come alive.

Game Modes

Solo Mode
Solo Mode delivers the complete Night Life experience with enhanced features and unrestricted access. Explore every venue in full detail, interact with NPC characters, and uncover experiences designed exclusively for solo play. Enjoy extended gameplay systems, curated NPC DJ sets, and the freedom to move through the world at your own pace, creating a more immersive and personalised nightlife journey.

Online Mode
Online Mode connects you with other players from around the world. When online, you appear as a hologram inside the venues, allowing seamless interaction with others. Meet up with friends, chat using proximity voice chat or text chat, and experience the energy of a shared virtual nightlife environment.

Features

Private Home Hub
Begin in your personal home space. Design your avatar, stream live radio stations 24 hours a day, or relax while watching shows on your virtual TV.

Live Club Sessions
Enter fully interactive nightclubs featuring live DJ events from real world DJs, NPC DJ performances, dynamic visuals, DJ lighting and mini-games. Dance, socialise and experience club culture in real time.

Whether you're looking to relax at home, meet new people, or light up the dancefloor, Night Life: Club Sessions offers a unique and immersive clubbing experience—anytime, anywhere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or greater.
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 470/570 or greater.
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 or greater.
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / AMD RX 590 or greater
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
